name: Warden
role: front-line tank: holds the front row, soaks hits, controls the timeline
description: Plate, a shield and a short temper. The Warden stands in front, takes the hits the party cannot, and makes the enemy wait.

schools.name: Bulwark
schools.philosophy: Shield, block, damage soak. The hit that lands on you is a hit that did not land on them.

schools.name: Vanguard
schools.philosophy: Spear and reach. Hit first and hit the back row from the front.

schools.name: Warcry
schools.philosophy: Shouts that buff the party and shake the enemy; the Warden as the loudest thing in the room.

aiRuleDefault: IF self HP < 30% THEN item small hp potion on self; IF allies count > 1 AND ally HP < 40% THEN provoke; IF self HP < 60% AND self not status fortify THEN brace; ELSE shield slam front enemy

visual.notes: Wide shoulders and a shield silhouette; the shield must read at 200px.

pros: Toughest front line in the game
Daze and push-back skills delete enemy turns
Plate and shields from the first floor
cons: Slowest class in the game: Plate is −20 Speed
Low damage without the Vanguard school
Plate is weak to Pierce at the joints
